notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Shorter wait to begin the game.
[*] Removed the dialogue chat arrow when diaries/photos are shown.
[*] Very minor dialogue revisions [Story unaffected].
[*] Evan now moves a little quicker.
[*] 'Cut to Black' instead of 'Flash to White' in Restaurant scene.
[*] Player has more time to read during certain scenes.
[*] Text shaking is now slightly more obvious.
[*] Missing shadows added to the desks during the first flashback.
[*] Game is better optimized and is approx. 100mb leaner.
[/list]
